title: AI model vs agent harness vs orchestration layer
description: People mix up three totally different layers when they talk about AI agents. The model is the brain. The harness gives it hands, memory, and a loop to run in. The orchestration layer is what makes a bunch of them work together without you babysitting. Once you see the split, the whole space clicks. I break all of this down inside Agent Architects. Link in bio if you want in. skool.com/agent-architects/about
